'''Basalt''' is a [[magma-safe]] [[igneous extrusive layer|igneous extrusive]] [[stone]] which can form whole [[stone layers|layers]]. It is also the only [[igneous extrusive layer|igneous extrusive]] [[stone]] to contain [[Sunstone]].
